httpChecks.name: Discarded successful submit response followed by identical retry
httpChecks.result: 202 with identical caller jobId, ready raw retained, source conflict 409, cancel 200, GET 404, replay 410, legacy source-only 202

httpChecks.name: DELETE before POST request body completes
httpChecks.result: unknown UUID DELETE 200; late POST 410; GET 404; unauthorized and browser requests cannot create tombstones

contract.submit: POST /fact-jobs JSON {source, jobId?}; queue API submit({source, jobId?})
contract.jobId: lowercase UUID with version 1-8 and RFC variant; crypto.randomUUID() compatible
contract.sameSourceRetry: 202 same jobId; no additional queue work for running, waiting or retained ready/failed jobs
contract.sourceConflict: 409 for same jobId with a different canonical full-source SHA-256 fingerprint
contract.retired: 410 for same-source replay of a cancelled or expired ID; GET 404
contract.unknownDelete: 200 only after a tombstone is retained; 429 at capacity
contract.legacy: source-only requests still allocate a server UUID
contract.capacity: Active jobs reserve a ledger record at admission. Known cancellation can retire that reservation at full capacity. Unexpired tombstones are never evicted; new work and unknown cancellation fail closed with 429.

cleanup: Each test closes its queue or HTTP service in finally; the partially written HTTP request is destroyed in finally. npm check completed and no task service is intentionally left running.
limits: The ledger is process-local memory: no service-restart, replica-wide or permanent replay guarantee.
Protection is bounded to at least 31 minutes after actual cancellation/removal; a replay after that retention horizon may be admitted.
